Take Control


In Rail Recon, you are taking control of a reconnaissance robot tasked with discovering the depths and secrets of an old mining facility, known as "Project Tunnel". Communication with the outside world is cut, and armed only with a laser cannon you must fight through the facility's defenses to complete your mission.

  • Mazes of rails and puzzle-like traps make it clear, you are not welcome here.
  • Armed with a Laser cannon you must take out enemies on your way to the exit.
  • Collect crystals to power massive doors leading you to the next level.
  • Use your energy shield to absorb incoming fire, or destroy enemies by ramming them.

The Mining Facility


"Project Tunnel" was set up to create the world's first fully mechanized mining facility, but mysterious events sometime after its opening caused it to be shut down, leaving it abandoned. Now, years later, the surrounding areas are pestered with earthquakes and the mine is re-opened for investigation.

Finding the source of the anomaly draws many new investors.
Or are they attracted by the stories, stories about rare green crystals with an unimaginable power ...

Break into the mine. Discover its secrets. Escape.

data.short_description: Delve into the underground facility of Rail Recon, a Twin-stick Shooter with a Rail System. Navigate through its network of rails in search of its crystals, while maneuvering and fighting through the facility's defenses.

reviews.review:
I have played this game for 63 minutes and want to give my review.

The concept of this game is very good.

Short summary: You can drive on rails, start, stop and change your direction. You can shoot or apply your shield which uses power that you can reload on a specific place.
This is a [h1] brilliant idea [/h1] since shooting with the mouse is not all. You have to be skilled in shooting AND moving while you only can drive on your rails. 

I think many other games with mouse shooting are too simple. But this game is not easy to beat and to finish.
The controls make sense, too. Well made.
The necessity to shoot at certain targets to open doors is very good, too.
Another good idea: Switches within the rails and that you need to wait until the swith opens the rail.
The many rails in the levels are like a maze and you have to think about on which rails you should drive to get the collectable diamond in the easiest way, without being destroyed.
You have to collect all the diamonds to unlock the door and finish the level. So you have to remember which areas you have already visited. Great! I hope this won't be changed in an update and that there won't be a map for orientation because this would make it too easy.
.
.
Game concept:     10/10 points !!
.
.
The graphics are quite ok. They vary not much within the levels but are well done. In some levels the graphics is stuttering a bit and in other levels it runs smooth. There is a bit a motion blur effect that I don't really like and I think it would have been better to be able to turn this effect off.

Graphics: 8/10 points

The sounds are unique and nice, too.
Sounds: 7/10 points

Unfortunately the music is too monotone. This game is not easy to beat and so you have to repeat the levels in a relatively short interval - and each time you hear the same music and the same start of the music.
Music: 3/10 points

There are a few things I can't understand:
- meaning of the yellow lighting barrels that you can drive over.
- meaning of the crystals that grow on the walls and which you can shoot / destroy.
Perhaps these things have a meaning - but I don't understand it up to now.
- Why are all 9 levels unlocked although I have not played them one after another?

Negative aspects:

- There are only a few different enemies that can be destroyed. I think there's not enough variety.
- All enemies can be destroyed by only one hit.
- Your fire power is always the same. The sort of bullets and shots don't vary. Why can't you improve the interval of your bullets and the fire power?
- You can be destroyed by only 1 hit. Of course I know that the use of the shield is an important part and I think this should not be changed. However there should be the possibility to charge your armor / resistance of your tank.

So I want to summarize:
All in all there's not much variety in the music, in the sounds, in the enemies, in the shooting.........

- In the current moment (game has been just released) 24.01.2018, there's the bug that you cannot change your settings in the options menu. I have reported this bug in a threat and got the quick answer that this will be changed after an update.


Perhaps you ask yourself why I still want to recommend this game although I have found so many things that I think can be improved.

[h1] I RECOMMEND you this game because of the very unique and nice concept. Apart of that it is challenging and games that are not easy to beat and master are rare today. [/h1]

That's it ;-P

I hope I will see more of this type of game, maybe a next version of it.
Thumbs up !
